pathway.title: Run deliverable comparison
pathway.question: What changed between the prior and current deliverables?

blocks.title: Changes across the seven requested dimensions

cells.text: CP-1 chunks 1–2, “Financials and credit metrics”: FY2024/FY2023 revenue 7,940/6,585; EBITDA 3,813/3,148; EBITDA As Defined 4,173/3,395; cash 6,261/3,472; gross debt 25,068/19,913; gross-basis net debt 18,807/16,441, all USD millions. Primary displayed adjusted gross/net leverage 6.01x/4.51x for FY2024; adjusted EBITDA/net accrual interest 3.24x.

CP-1 chunks 1–2, same financial heading, repeats those annual amounts. “Reader summary” and “Chart data: leverage/interest cover” emphasize ordinary issuer EBITDA: FY2024 gross/net leverage 6.5744x/4.9323x and EBITDA/net cash interest 3.2927x. Adjusted leverage remains 6.0072x/4.5068x.

Accounting values are unchanged. Ratio differences are principally basis choices/analytical judgment, with two- versus four-decimal presentation precision, not numerical corrections. Coverage changes both earnings and interest definitions. Detailed operands below prevent false like-for-like comparisons.

CP-1 chunk 1, “Source context and extraction boundaries”: FY2024 2023-10-01–2024-09-30; FY2023 2022-10-01–2023-09-30; September 30 balance-sheet instants. CP-1A chunk 2 dates October 16 drawing and October 18 payment as subsequent events, and November 7, 2024 audit date.

CP-1 chunk 1, “Common financial scope,” retains the same durations/instants; CP-1A chunk 2 retains October 2024 payment/drawing as subsequent, with less day-level specificity. CP-0 chunk 1 retains the November 7, 2024 audit signature.

Unchanged financial periods and subsequent-event boundary; reduced day-level detail is a presentation change, not changed event timing. The one-day execution-date difference in November 2026 is not a new accounting observation. December 2024 operations remain outside the annual base on both sides.

CP-1 chunks 2–4, bridges E/F/G: gross debt includes finance leases, refundable advances and securitization; excludes operating leases; all reported consolidated cash is netted without access certification; actual annual earnings, no acquisition annualization. Adjusted earnings receive greater display prominence.

CP-1 chunks 1–4, “Financial base view,” chart tables and ratio bridges: same debt/cash perimeter; ordinary net-income-based issuer EBITDA becomes primary. Liquidity chart uses revolving availability only, 843/755, excluding conditional securitization capacity.

Analytical judgment and presentation/basis expansion, not new source facts. Neither run proves unrestricted cash, covenant EBITDA, normalized earnings or a borrower-only perimeter. Revolver-only chart headroom is not the prior total liquidity metric.

CP-1 chunk 3, “Evidence-based credit interpretation”: gross leverage rises, cash-netted leverage falls, coverage improves, declared distribution qualifies cash. CP-1A chunk 3: supportive reporting-quality topic, Neutral creditor-treatment topic; no governance score or risk level stated.

CP-1 chunk 1 summary repeats the gross/net tension and improves cash-cover narrative. CP-1A chunks 2–3: Mixed disclosure transparency, reporting quality and creditor-treatment topics, additional acquisition/amendment flags; publishes qualitative governance risk “High,” driven by extraction.

Core credit interpretation is unchanged. More explicit caution and qualitative governance labeling are analytical judgment/scope expansion. Current adds acquisition-pro-forma nondisclosure and control-evaluation exclusions as counterweights, not evidence of a new deterioration, breach or control deficiency.

CP-0 chunk 1 inventory and CP-1 chunk 1 source table retain the annual filing plus four supplemental issuer renditions/interims. CP-1 segment binding uses K pages 49–50. CP-1A chunks 1–2 leaves geographic split absent and SEI funding breakdown unestablished in that summary.

CP-0 chunk 1 retains the same issuer hashes; CP-1 chunk 2 uses Annual page 164 for identical segment totals plus channel detail. CP-1A chunks 1–2 adds top-ten customer share approximately 42%, domestic/foreign sales 5,032/2,908, FPT and individual acquisition funding/prices from Annual pages 9, 165 and 131–137.

No issuer-source version change; settings change and broader located coverage. Added facts close parts of prior fact-pack coverage gaps; they are scope expansion, not newly occurring events. Shift from MD&A segment pages to note page 164 preserves the same totals and adds granularity.

CP-1 chunk 3 bridges C2/C3 and chunk 4 Gaps explicitly retain asset/liability cash-use magnitudes 302/431 versus issuer bridge 272/415, differences 30/16 unresolved. CP-1A chunk 3 carries that limitation. Both preserve missing legal documents, cutoff, preparation assurance and facility precision.

CP-1 chunk 4, full CFO bridge, says no unresolved CFO reconciliation difference remains but does not explain the prior 30/16 classification difference; CP-1A chunk 3 conflicts register instead emphasizes 487 versus 487.5 drawn and 163 versus 162.5 available. Cutoff, legal, preparation and settlement gaps persist.

The full CFO tie is not a demonstrated correction/resolution of the separate classification comparison: unresolved. Facility precision and payable-to-payment reconciliation remain open. Current adds clearer all-funding maturity exclusions and acquisition-control qualifications; these are scope/qualification expansion, not removal of core limitations.

Receipt chunk 1: literal handoff delivery, CP-MODEL not published, analytical runtime not executed, no Excel output. view.json chunk 1 requests CP-1/CP-1A with copied CP-0 included. report-view.json chunk 1 has four pathway blocks: company-operating-model, financials-credit-metrics, company-profile, transaction-summary.

Receipt chunk 1 retains the same publication/runtime flags and six-file map. view.json chunk 1 requests CP-0/CP-1/CP-1A. report-view.json chunk 1 inserts model-chart-strip after operating model; selector searches locate its four chart/table-twin bindings in chunks 2–3 and 49. All three handoffs add reader summaries.

Presentation and scope expansion: refreshed CP-0, summaries, richer registers and embedded report charts. Neither bundle publishes a standalone HTML Model, charts file or calculation JSON. Both publish CP-0.md, CP-1.md, CP-1A.md, view.json, report-view.json and report.html. A Model navigation label does not establish model publication.
